title: 第1393章 得罪天柱山开启仙城大阵第1392章 掌管仙城无奈暴露
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
第1393章得罪天柱山，开启仙城大阵
“大胆，你竟然口出狂言，圣人身份尊贵无比，哪是你有资格相见的。”
天柱山修士无不愤怒，圣人，对他们而言是真正的仙，是不可触碰、不可忤逆、更不可玷污的至高存在。
胡祁脸色冷了下来，身上狂暴无比的半步合道气息浮现。
陆青禾不甘示弱，他花费如此大代价，还在秘境之中吃了如此大亏，怎么可能圣人一句话就将一座仙城拱手相让。
陆青禾也不怕得罪这些修士。
“这里是天虚仙城，还请道友不要自误。”
一道道身影出现在虚空之上，这些是林傲霜这段时间招收的修士，一百尊化神修士，三十尊炼虚修士。
还有玄尘这样的炼虚八重天修士。
看到这样的情况，胡祁问道：“道友真的要与天柱山为敌？”
陆青禾摇摇头：“与天柱山为敌本座自然是不敢，只是你们一句话就要夺走仙城，本座的损失如何计算？”
“哪怕是圣人来了，也需要公平公正。”
陆青禾这话完全是屁话，巧取豪夺，杀人夺宝不过是修仙界的常态，可是这样的情况下，圣人动手，那事情就不一样。
圣人和普通修士还是不一样的。
除非在必要情况下，圣人不会做出这样让人唾弃的事情来。
胡祁也知道陆青禾的打算，他眼底发狠，手中拿出一柄赤红色的天剑：“忤逆圣人，你自是当诛。”
恐怖的道器威压笼罩整个天虚仙城。
陆青禾拿出一枚令牌，原本消散的天虚防御大阵在这个时候运转了起来。
陆青禾冷漠地问道：“道友真的想与天虚仙城为敌不成？”
无数人惊骇，没有想到紫天一真的将天虚仙城卖给了陆青禾，陆青禾更是将天虚仙城的防御大阵重启。

众人更是惊骇陆青禾的态度，这完全是要将天柱山得罪死了。
竟然敢质问天柱山，紫云星的仙门都没有这个胆子。
胡祁呆呆地看着被开启的仙城大阵，他犹豫了，他知道自己在这里根本不可能是陆青禾的对手。
他不知道陆青禾是什么身份，但是看出是和他一样的修为。
再加上仙城防御大阵，还有那些虎视眈眈的修士，天柱山修士讨不到任何好处。
胡祁冷笑道：“好一个天虚仙城，本座记住了，本座会将这里的事情如实上报，到时候自会有圣人定夺。”
胡祁拿出天舟带着天柱山的修士离开，只是被仙城大阵挡住了。
胡祁脸色一变，扭头看向陆青禾的方向：“道友莫非今日要和天柱山开战？”
陆青禾想了一下，打开缺口，将天柱山的修士放走了。
然后他扭头看着其他愕然的三位修士，其中包括木青，这是天虚仙城现在最强的力量。
陆青禾拱手：“三位道友，接下来本座要掌管天虚仙城，三位若是要离开天虚仙城，通报本座一声就行了。”
他也不想和三人开战，但是三人如果要阻止他，他不介意将三人干掉，木青是不可能和他动手的。
其他两人，他有把握直接镇杀在天虚仙城之中。
content_en:
Chapter 1393: Offending Tianzhu Mountain and opening the Immortal City Formation
"Bold, you actually spoke arrogantly. The saint's status is extremely noble, you are not qualified to meet him."
The monks in Tianzhu Mountain are all angry. To them, saints are real immortals, supreme beings who cannot be touched, disobeyed, and undefiled.
Hu Qi's face turned cold, and the extremely violent Half-Step Hedao aura emerged from his body.
Lu Qinghe was not to be outdone. He spent so much money and suffered such a big loss in the secret realm. How could a saint give up a fairy city with just one word?
Lu Qinghe is not afraid of offending these monks.
"This is Tianxu Immortal City, please don't make any mistakes, fellow Taoist."
Figures appeared in the void one after another. These were the monks Lin Aoshuang had recruited during this period, one hundred god-transformation monks and thirty void-refining monks.
There are also eighth-level monks like Xuan Chen.
Seeing this situation, Hu Qi asked: "Do you really want to be an enemy of Tianzhu Mountain?"
Lu Qinghe shook his head: "Of course I don't dare to be an enemy of Tianzhu Mountain, but you will take away the Immortal City with just one word. How do you calculate my losses?"
"Even if a saint comes, he still needs to be fair and just."
Lu Qinghe's words are completely nonsense. Taking advantage of others by clever means and killing people to seize treasures are just the norm in the world of immortality. But in this case, if a saint takes action, things will be different.
Saints are still different from ordinary monks.
A saint would not do such a despicable thing unless necessary.
Hu Qi also knew Lu Qinghe's plan. His eyes were fierce and he took out a red heavenly sword in his hand: "You will be punished for disobeying the saint."
The terrifying Taoist pressure enveloped the entire Tianxu Immortal City.
Lu Qinghe took out a token, and the Tianxu defense formation that had originally dissipated began to move at this time.
Lu Qinghe asked indifferently: "Do you really want to be an enemy of Tianxu Immortal City?"
Countless people were horrified. They did not expect that Zi Tianyi would actually sell Tianxu Immortal City to Lu Qinghe, and Lu Qinghe would even restart the defense array of Tianxu Immortal City.
Everyone was even more horrified by Lu Qinghe's attitude, which was totally going to offend Tianzhu Mountain to death.
He actually dared to question Tianzhu Mountain. None of the Immortal Sects in Ziyun Star had the courage.
Hu Qi stared blankly at the opened Immortal City Formation. He hesitated. He knew that he could not be Lu Qinghe's opponent here.
He didn't know who Lu Qinghe was, but he could tell that he had the same cultivation level as him.
Coupled with the Immortal City's defense formation and those monks who were eyeing him, the Tianzhu Mountain monks could not get any benefits.
Hu Qi sneered and said: "What a Tianxu Immortal City. I will remember it. I will report the things here truthfully. When the time comes, a saint will make a decision."
Hu Qi took out the Tianzhou and took the monks from Tianzhu Mountain away, but was blocked by the Immortal City Formation.
Hu Qi's expression changed and he turned to look in the direction of Lu Qinghe: "Is Taoist Fellow Daoist going to fight Tianzhu Mountain today?"
Lu Qinghe thought for a moment, opened the gap, and let the monks from Tianzhu Mountain go.
Then he turned to look at the other three astonished monks, including Mu Qing, who was the strongest force in Tianxu Immortal City now.
Lu Qinghe handed over his hands: "Three fellow Taoists, I will be in charge of Tianxu Immortal City next. If the three of you want to leave Tianxu Immortal City, just inform me."
He didn't want to start a fight with the three of them, but if the three of them tried to stop him, he wouldn't mind killing them. Mu Qing wouldn't be able to fight him.
He was confident of killing the other two people directly in Tianxu Immortal City.
